packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Unbound template guard
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Lets prose through without treating an unfilled template placeholder as real data.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Operational memory
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Records what an agent's tools observed, sorts out what kind of error occurred, and schedules a retry after a failure.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Run executor
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Runs one agent run from start to finish, keeping its lease alive and recording a clean failure if it breaks.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Failure in words
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Turns the machine labels on a failed tool result into words the model can read.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Card capabilities note
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Builds the per-turn note telling the model which generated-UI pieces it may use.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Card compiler
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Builds a rich generated-UI card from the turn's real evidence, refusing to show numbers or results the broker has not confirmed.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Card vocabulary
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Builds the list of card building blocks the model may use, straight from the live rules so it can never drift.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Turn outcomes
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Decides how a turn ends: a final reply, or a saved wait for an answer, the owner's attention, or an outside event.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Restore a run
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Brings a run back from its last saved point before the loop continues, applying any owner answer or outside wake it carries.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Model failure recovery
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Decides what a run does after every model option has failed — how long to wait and when to escalate.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Model turn
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Runs one request to the AI model, turning stable tool references into real calls and guarding money claims before the loop sees the reply.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Choice tracking
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Tracks what a question's choice was bound to do and what a tapped choice still has to finish.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Progress line
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Produces the live progress line shown while an agent works.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Public streaming guard
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Streams the reply as it is written while keeping any result claim final-only.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Checkpoint restore
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Reads a run's saved messages and pending calls back from its checkpoint.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Reply formatting fix
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Fixes bold markers the model wrote with a stray space inside them.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Run scope check
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Confirms a tool call belongs to the current run, agent, conversation and owner.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Runtime notices
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Places the runtime's notices where the model will read them, in the owner's language, never as mid-run system text.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Agent runtime
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Sets up a run with its tools and limits and executes it.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skills package
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Marks the engine's skills code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill reads
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Lets a run read its skills step by step, binding each read to a receipt so the content is real.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Owner skill catalog
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Builds the list of skills the owner can see.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill document
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Reads a skill's name and description, while the server stays the authority on what it is allowed to do.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Instruction skills
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Lets an agent save a text-only skill in one go, with versions it can restore.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill packages
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Manages an agent's skill package versions, their stored files, and running their helper scripts safely in the owner's workspace.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill loader
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Loads the built-in skills, prompts and the mandatory runtime rules.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Pinned packages
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Prepares and validates pinned skill packages, without trusting their publisher.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Package file rules
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Enforces the size and path rules of a skill package's files and fingerprints them.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill origin labels
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Labels every skill the model sees with where it really came from and how far it is trusted.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill registry
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Holds the set of installed skills and checks the shipped ones resolve at startup.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Public skill inspection
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Inspects a public skill package without ever running its code.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill selection
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Decides which skills are eligible and selects them for a turn.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill file copies
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Writes an enabled skill version's files into the agent's workspace, where its scripts run.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill context selection
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Picks the skill instructions to include within a budget.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill snapshots
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Keeps a bounded snapshot of the skills chosen for the current run.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skill file store
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Stores and reads the files of an agent's skill package versions.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: System rules
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Selects the first-party rules the agent must follow, by what it is actually doing, never by keywords.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Card-writing rules
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: The part of the system prompt that teaches the agent how to build generated-UI cards.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Mid-run steering
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Folds in the owner's new input and the server's notices while a run is working.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Stop gates
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Stops a model from ending a run while a task or responsibility is still unfinished.
